sentences.text: Genome analysis of the type strains of three Terrisporobacter species described them as acetogenic bacteria and identified a gene cluster for a reductive proline-dependent Stickland reaction found only in this genus.
Case reports describe Terrisporobacter glycolicus as the sole cause of gas gangrene of the upper limb in a young man, and Terrisporobacter muris in the blood of a critically ill elderly man.
A Mendelian randomization study reported a causal association between a genetically predicted higher abundance of the gut genus Terrisporobacter and an increased risk of papillary thyroid carcinoma.
